stem.text: Two blocks K and L slide towards each other along a horizontal frictionless surface.
The diagram shows the momentum of the two blocks just before they collide.

stem.alt: Two square blocks labelled K (left) and L (right) on a horizontal surface. Above K an arrow points right labelled 0.72 kg m s-1; above L an arrow points left labelled 0.46 kg m s-1.

stem.text: During the collision, the blocks are in contact with each other for a time of $0.084\,\text{s}$.
After the collision, the blocks separate and block L moves back along its original path with a momentum of $0.12\,\text{kg m s}^{-1}$.
What is the magnitude of the average force exerted on block L by block K during the collision?
